messages:
maria: Heads up — after the RBAC role flip in keystore-admin last night the SAST runner started failing to decrypt build artifacts. Blocking ~12 PRs in platform/* . Error logs:
```
Error: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User 'svc-scan-runner' not authorized to use key 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/scanner-key'
Status: 403
```
Can someone revert the role binding or grant svc-scan-runner the decrypt permission? @devon @olivia :warning:

devon: On it. I just saw the spike in decrypt errors in telemetry. Planning to roll back the binding in ~2 mins. Which binding did we change exactly? Link to change: https://git.internal/infra/changes/PR-5423

ash: Is this also causing SAST artifact mismatches (hash errors) or just decrypt failures? I noticed a couple FPs where sources couldn't be fetched earlier today.

maria: Just decrypt. The SAST job retries but treats failures as file-not-found -> marks a finding as untriaged which looks like a new vuln. So effectively FPs and triage noise.

olivia: I'm oncall — please add an incident tag and ping security_reviewers. Quick triage plan: revert binding -> restart runners -> re-run affected scans -> mark PRs for re-eval. I'll open an incident ticket and collect audit logs.

devon: Rolled back the binding at 1733332100. Restarting runners now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/scan-runner -n cicd`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout restart triggered by devon at 1733332150. New pods becoming ready 3/3. :repeat:

ci-bot: ci-bot: queued re-run for batch-173333 (12 PRs). ETA ~8 minutes.

maria: Re-run kicked off for the affected PRs. First run shows decrypt success on pod scan-runner-5c4b. Waiting for full pass.

ash: If runners had stale IAM bindings we should also rotate ephemeral tokens and add a backfill to re-run failed scans automatically. Suggest adding a unit check in iam-change pipeline to validate keystore decrypt for svc accounts.

olivia: :white_check_mark: Filing postmortem ticket: https://jira.redwood/RED-SEC-204 — will include timeline + owners. Please add logs & PR list.

devon: I'll add an iam-check to the infra pipeline to notify sec on keystore binding changes. Proposal: require `security_approval` label on merges touching `infra/keystore` or IAM rolebindings.

maria: Thanks. Action items: (1) devon add iam-check + notify; (2) ash add scan-detection for KMS decrypt errors with auto-retry/backoff and a re-run hook for PR scans; (3) olivia file postmortem + collect audit logs. I'll follow up on the PR list.

olivia: Closing incident once all PRs green. Please paste relevant logs into the Jira ticket and tag with `sast-fp-kms`.

maria: Update — all 12 PRs re-ran and are green now. No remaining false positives. Closing thread. 1733333456 :tada:
